messages:
PSYCHIC~VIRGIL sent out Bronzong
and Dusclops!

The opposing Dusclops is
exerting its pressure!

The opposing Bronzong flinched
and couldn’t move!

The opposing Dusclops twisted
the dimensions!

The opposing Dusclops couldn’t fully
protect itself
Urshifu was hurt by its burn!
Incineroar was damaged by the recoil!
Urshifu was hurt by its burn!

Incineroar knocked off the opposing
Bronzong’s Menta

Incineroar was hurt by the opposing
Chimecho’s Rocky

Incineroar knocked off the opposing
Chimecho’s Rocky

The twisted dimensions
returned to normal!

The opposing Porygon2
avoided the attack!

Gengar’s Gengarite is reacting
to BRENDAN’s Mega Rin

Gengar has Mega Evolved
into Mega Gengar!

Incineroar knocked off the opposing
Porygon2’s Eviol

The opposing Medicham’s Medichamite
is reacting to V

The opposing Medicham has Mega
Evolved into Mega Med
